1f8ad9b25347e9bd.description: Job Purpose: Operates in all clinic areas and in-patient areas to conduct echocardiogram (TTE and TEE), stress testing (treadmill, Dobutamine and thallium / Sestamibi with the nuclear imaging), and 24 hour holter (ECG) and BP monitoring procedures. Performs on patients of both sexes and all nationalities, thus ethical and cultural sensitivities are of paramount importance in the way the work is done. Coordinates with the cardiologists and specialists for supervision and reports. Key Responsibilities and Duties: 1. Echocardiograms Transthoracic Echocardiogram ( TTE ): Performs 2D echo Doppler studies on adult, pediatric and neonatal patients and writes down the preliminary results. Notifies cardiologists of suspected abnormalities necessitating immediate attention (e.g. Pericardial tamponade, cardiac tumors, malfunctioning valve prosthesis and complex congenital heart disease, etc.). Prepares reports / videos of patients for official reading of the Consultant Cardiologist. Maintains documentation and down-time equipment used in the Echo lab. Maintains statistics, patient record and area monthly report. Reports to supervisor / department head any staff problems / malfunction of the echo equipment. Requests and obtains outpatients charts on all scheduled patients. Maintains supplies as needed for the examination room. Maintains daily the examination room in a clean and orderly environment for patient care (including changing the bed sheets). Maintains daily census record of Echo procedures completed. 2. Trans-esophageal Echocardiogram ( TEE ) if applicable: Performs pre-procedure equipment preparation and sterilization and acquisition of signed consent form. Acquires quick history and physical examination about the nature of the disease. Helps the patient to understand what to expect, alleviate anxiety and enhance compliance during TEE examination. Also a brief drug and allergy history or dysphagia or esophageal disease should be elicited. line to administer sedation or emergency medications. Advises patient to remove dentures and places the mouth piece. Instructs the patient to lie on his left lateral position with neck and knee bent forward and swallowing during intubations with nasal breathing. Be alert in monitoring vital signs and complications. Monitor s the patient after the procedure at least 1-2 hours for potential complication of the procedures, anesthetic or sedative. Maintains census record of the procedure completed. 3. Stress Test: Treadmill Exercise Test, Dobutamine Stress Test, Exercise Sestamibi and Presenting Sestamibi. Prior to the test, explains the procedure to the patient: to dress comfortably ( e.g. loose fitting, light weight clothing and sports shoes not to eat a heavy meal 4-8 hours before the test Asks the patient to sign a consent form as per policy. Explains the procedure in detail and re-assure the patient if he/she is anxious. Garment/s above the waist should be removed temporarily in order to attach 10 disposable electrodes. Prepares the skin area where the electrodes are to be attached like shaving the area if necessary, rubbing the skin vigorously with alcohol swabs. Connects the lead wires to the patient s electrodes (lead wires are color coded). Position the cable yoke so that the cable does not interrupt the patient when he/she is on the treadmill. Records ECG preferably with the patient lying and standing. Takes the patient s blood pressure, preferably with the patient lying and standing. Sets the maximum heart rate to be reached for the patient in question. Ensures the crash cart is ready for use should an emergency arise. Maintains daily census record of the procedure completed. 4. Holter Monitoring: Explains the test to the patient. Asks the patient to remove clothing above the waist. Skin preparation: shaves hair if necessary, rub the electrodes sites several times with alcohol swabs. Attaches the electrodes for a two channel recording as shown in the operator s manual. Fix the electrodes with adhesive plaster. Attaches the cable lead wires following color coding as shown in the operator s manual. Makes stress loops to prevent from pulling the electrodes. After 24 hours, switch off the monitor and disconnect the patient cable lead wires from the electrodes. Take off and discard the electrodes. Process the unit in the computer by typing all the necessary information about the patient, scanning and saving the ECG tracings recorded for 24 hours then to be ready for analyzing of the specialist / consultant cardiologist. Maintains daily census record of the procedure completed. 5. Ambulatory Blood Pressure Monitoring: Explains the test to the patient and its indication. Sets the machine to check blood pressure every 15-30 minutes during the day and every 1-2 hours during sleeping time. After 24 hours, disconnect from the patient and scan it in the computer. Maintains daily census record of procedure completed. 6. Educates patients and their families about health conditions, treatments and preventative measures if applicable. Desired Candidate Profile Experience : Minimum of 3 years of practical experience Education : BS Medical Technology or any related medical field Language: English and Arabic preferred. Licenses / Certifications: License for practice as per the regional health regulatory authority e.g. (SCFHS / DHA), ACLS and BLS

1f07f08481597161.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة اغادير نجد للمقاولات عن فني كهربائي تمديدات كهربائية للانضمام إلى فريقها في عرعر، الحدود الشمالية. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على دراسة مخططات التمديدات الكهربائية، تقدير المواد، متابعة التنفيذ، وتشخيص الأعطال لضمان سلامة وكفاءة الأنظمة الكهربائية. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في المجال. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية دراسة وتحليل مخططات التمديدات الكهربائية للمشاريع المنزلية، الصناعية، والتجارية ومكوناتها بدقة. تقدير كميات المواد والأجهزة المطلوبة لتنفيذ أعمال التمديدات الكهربائية وتأمين التجهيزات اللازمة مع مطابقة مواصفاتها الفنية. متابعة تنفيذ أعمال التمديدات الكهربائية، بما في ذلك متابعة تشغيل الدارات الكهربائية وإجراء الفحوصات اللازمة مثل فحوصات العازلية، الاستمرارية، والتأريض. تشخيص أعطال التمديدات الكهربائية وتحديد الإجراءات التصحيحية اللازمة لمعالجتها، بالإضافة إلى متابعة أعمال الصيانة الوقائية. تطبيق إجراءات وتعليمات السلامة والصحة المهنية في جميع مراحل العمل لضمان بيئة عمل آمنة. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال التمديدات الكهربائية. القدرة على قراءة وفهم المخططات الكهربائية المختلفة. معرفة قوية بأساسيات الكهرباء وأنظمة التمديدات. المهارات والكفاءات مهارات تشخيص الأعطال وإيجاد الحلول الفعالة. الالتزام بمعايير السلامة والصحة المهنية. القدرة على العمل بشكل مستقل وكجزء من فريق. بيئة العمل هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل ويقع في مدينة عرعر بمنطقة الحدود الشمالية. سيعمل الفني ضمن فريق متخصص في مشاريع المقاولات المتنوعة. تقديم الطلبات للمهتمين بالانضمام إلى شركة اغادير نجد للمقاولات، يرجى تقديم طلباتكم. سيتم تحديد الراتب بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات.

1f12626c3bbf6424.description: About the Role Tamam is seeking a Credit Risk Manager to support the development and enhancement of the company’s credit risk framework, portfolio monitoring, and risk analytics. This full-time position is based in Riyadh and requires 5-10 years of experience. The role will focus on SME credit portfolios, ensuring effective assessment of credit quality, portfolio performance, provisioning, and emerging risk trends. Key Responsibilities Monitor and assess credit portfolio performance across SME, corporate, and retail exposures. Review and assess IFRS 9 and ECL methodologies, including PD, LGD, EAD, staging criteria, macroeconomic factors, and management overlays. Analyze portfolio quality, delinquency, aging, concentration, provisioning, and risk classification. Identify emerging credit risks, portfolio deterioration trends, and areas requiring management attention. Perform financial statement and credit risk analysis to assess borrowers’ financial position and repayment capacity. Support the development and enhancement of credit risk models, scorecards, policies, and portfolio monitoring tools. Review controls related to credit approval, disbursement, monitoring, and provisioning processes. Support stress testing, portfolio segmentation, and credit risk assessments where required. Prepare regular credit risk reports, analysis, and recommendations for senior management and relevant committees. Work closely with Finance, Credit, Collections, Data, Compliance, and Business teams on credit risk-related initiatives. Qualifications and Experience 5-10 years of experience in credit risk management. Strong experience in credit risk, IFRS 9, Expected Credit Loss (ECL), and financial analysis. Exposure to banking, lending, FinTech, or financial risk advisory environments. Work Location This position is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. Employment Type This is a full-time employment opportunity.

1f1c9d6e411e61ca.description: نبذة عن الدور يبحث معهد تطوير الموارد البشرية العالي للتدريب عن مدرب تقنية معلومات للانضمام إلى فريقه في الخفجي، المنطقة الشرقية. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على تدريس المقررات الدراسية وتقديم الدورات التدريبية المتخصصة في مجال تقنية المعلومات، سواء ضمن نظم التعليم القائمة أو لدعمها. المسؤوليات الرئيسية وضع خطط الدروس بما يتناسب مع أهداف التعليم والتدريب، واختيار المصادر التعليمية المناسبة. تصميم المواد التعليمية والدروس والدورات التدريبية، بالإضافة إلى تحديد طرق التدريس والمحتوى. تدريس موضوعات تقنية المعلومات، وتقديم الدروس والدورات التدريبية الفردية والجماعية. إعطاء الواجبات وتنظيم الأنشطة العملية لتعزيز الفهم والتطبيق. تحديد أهداف واضحة للتعلم، وإعداد الاختبارات والواجبات وإدارتها، ووضع الدرجات لتقييم تقدم الطلاب. تقديم المشورة للطلاب لتحسين كفاءتهم، وتحديد الطلاب الذين يحتاجون إلى اهتمام إضافي وتحديد الطرق المناسبة لتلبية احتياجاتهم. مساعدة المدرسين في نظم التعليم السائدة التي تُقدم فيها دروس تقنية المعلومات. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة في مجال تدريب تقنية المعلومات أو مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على تدريس مقررات تقنية المعلومات بفعالية. مهارات ممتازة في التواصل والعرض. بيئة العمل هذا الدور بدوام كامل في الخفجي، المنطقة الشرقية، ويوفر فرصة للعمل في بيئة تعليمية ديناميكية تساهم في تطوير مهارات الأفراد في مجال تقنية المعلومات. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا الدور سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات، وسيتم الإفصاح عنه خلال عملية المقابلة. نشجع المرشحين المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه على التقديم.

1f4d9d563281c00e.company_name: Royal Commission for Jubail and Yanbu
1f4d9d563281c00e.description: About the Role The Royal Commission for Jubail and Yanbu is seeking a Consultant - Neurosurgery to join their team in Yanbu. This full-time position requires a professional with 2-5 years of experience in the field of specialization, focusing on patient care and clinical decision-making within a recognized hospital or health center. Key Responsibilities Make decisions regarding the patient's plan of care. Treat patients and their families with respect and dignity. Interact professionally with patients and their families, involving them in the formation of the care plan. Conduct daily clinical rounds personally or through a designated person, if applicable. Be available for calls after hours if problems related to their patients arise. Examine, assess, and provide investigation and treatment orders for medical/surgical patients admitted under their care in a timely manner, as indicated by RCMC policies and procedures. Qualifications and Experience Saudi Nationality is required. Hold valid SCFHS classification and registration. Graduate from a recognized medical school and hold a Saudi board or equivalent degree. Possess a specialty qualification or equivalent. Complete a period of experience not less than 3 years in the field of specialization in a recognized hospital or health center. Work Environment This role is based in Yanbu and involves working within a professional healthcare setting, adhering to established policies and procedures to ensure high standards of patient care. Application Process Candidates who meet the specified requirements are encouraged to apply for this full-time position.

1f602d5839caf3f1.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة البوابة الشرقية للخدمات اللوجستية عن مشرف صحة وسلامة مهنية للانضمام إلى فريقها في الدمام، المنطقة الشرقية. يهدف هذا الدور بدوام كامل إلى ضمان تطبيق معايير ولوائح الصحة والسلامة المهنية في المنشآت، والتحقيق في الحوادث، وإعداد التقارير اللازمة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية ضمان الالتزام بسياسات وإجراءات ومتطلبات السلامة والصحة المهنية (HSE) المعمول بها. إجراء جولات تفتيش دورية للسلامة في مواقع العمل وتحديد المخاطر المحتملة. إعداد ومتابعة تقييمات المخاطر وخطط الإجراءات التصحيحية. متابعة معدات مكافحة الحريق، مخارج الطوارئ، ولوحات وإرشادات السلامة. التحقيق في الحوادث والإصابات والحوادث الوشيكة، وإعداد التقارير ذات الصلة. تنفيذ برامج التوعية والتدريب على السلامة للموظفين. متابعة التزام المقاولين والزوار بمتطلبات وإجراءات السلامة في الموقع. إعداد ورفع تقارير دورية عن أداء السلامة إلى الإدارة. المؤهلات والخبرات شهادة NEBOSH IGC – شرط أساسي. شهادة OSHA 30-Hour – تعتبر ميزة إضافية. خبرة عملية ذات صلة في مجال الصحة والسلامة المهنية (HSE)، ويفضل أن تكون في بيئة المستودعات، الخدمات اللوجستية، مناولة الشحنات، أو العمليات التشغيلية. خبرة عملية في تقييم المخاطر (Risk Assessment) وتحليل سلامة العمل (JSA). معرفة جيدة بإجراءات الصحة والسلامة المهنية، والاستجابة لحالات الطوارئ، وخطط الإخلاء، والسلامة من الحرائق. المهارات المطلوبة القدرة على إجراء التحقيقات في الحوادث والإصابات والحوادث الوشيكة، وإعداد التقارير وخطط الإجراءات التصحيحية. القدرة على إجراء جولات تفتيش السلامة في موقع العمل وتحديد المخاطر المحتملة. القدرة على اجتياز اختبارات هيئة الطيران المدني المتعلقة بالسلامة التشغيلية في المطارات. بيئة العمل يعمل شاغل الوظيفة بدوام كامل ضمن فريق شركة البوابة الشرقية للخدمات اللوجستية في الدمام، المنطقة الشرقية، مع التركيز على تطبيق معايير السلامة في بيئات العمل اللوجستية والتشغيلية. التقديم ندعو المهتمين ممن تنطبق عليهم المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم على هذا الدور.

1f7d22ea507ef576.description: About the Role Jazeera Paints is seeking a Showroom Labor to join their team in Dammam. This full-time position involves supporting showroom operations through various physical tasks, ensuring products are well-managed and the showroom is prepared for inventory and customer needs. Key Responsibilities Load, unload, prepare, and arrange products within the showroom and storage areas. Participate in the handling of materials to and from warehouses. Move and lift tools and equipment as instructed by the direct supervisor. Ensure all damaged products are identified and isolated. Prepare the store for inventory checks. Execute all assigned activities using safe and environmentally sound methods. Perform any other duties assigned by the direct supervisor or manager. Work Environment This role is based in Dammam and operates on a full-time schedule. The Showroom Labor will work as part of a team, contributing to the efficient functioning of the showroom and warehouse logistics. Application Process Candidates interested in this Showroom Labor position are encouraged to apply. Further details regarding the application process will be provided upon inquiry.

1f8212e2fde565b7.description: About the Role Saudi Entertainment Ventures | SEVEN is seeking a Future Opportunity Finance Manager to join their team in Jazan, Jīzān, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves serving as an embedded finance business partner for Operations, providing financial leadership, strategic insights, and decision support to venue management teams. The Finance Manager will be instrumental in driving profitability and cost optimization across all entertainment destinations. Key Responsibilities Manage venue P&L performance by overseeing financial results for assigned destinations, analyzing revenue streams (tickets, F&B, retail, attractions), monitoring operating costs, and taking actions to achieve EBITDA and profitability targets. Provide financial business partnering by advising venue and operations managers, participating in operational planning, translating financial data into actionable insights, and influencing decisions at the idea stage. Analyze operational metrics, tracking key performance indicators such as per capita spend, attendance versus forecast, revenue per visitor, labor cost ratios, and F&B margins, and recommending improvements. Support budgeting and forecasting by collaborating with venue managers to develop accurate budgets and forecasts, incorporating seasonality, event calendars, and operational capacity, and providing variance analysis with corrective recommendations. Drive cost optimization by identifying opportunities to reduce operating costs without compromising guest experience, analyzing labor scheduling efficiency, monitoring vendor costs, and implementing cost control initiatives with operations leadership. Ensure financial controls by overseeing cash handling procedures, monitoring inventory management and shrinkage, ensuring compliance with financial policies, and supporting internal and external audits of operational areas. Develop and lead the team by setting objectives for operations finance analysts, providing coaching and mentorship, and building a high-performing team. Qualifications and Requirements A minimum of 5-10 years of relevant experience is required. Education: Bachelor's Degree (minimum) in Finance, Accounting, or Business Administration. Advanced Degree: MBA preferred. Professional Certifications: Certified Management Accountant (preferred), Certified Public Accountant (advantageous). Work Type This is a full-time position based in Jazan, Jīzān, Saudi Arabia.

1f8395972b7a4a51.description: About the Role Everhires is seeking a Technical Sales Engineer specializing in Painting Equipment to join its Painting Equipment Division. This full-time position is based in the Makkah region, covering Jeddah and Makkah. The successful candidate will be responsible for driving sales growth, identifying new business opportunities, managing key accounts, and providing technical support for industrial coating and painting equipment solutions. Key Responsibilities Achieve and exceed individual sales goals and targets consistently. Drive sales, marketing, and servicing efforts for company products and services within assigned accounts, projects, or business areas. Identify and pursue new business opportunities to expand market presence and achieve sales targets in alignment with organizational objectives. Develop strategies to achieve sales targets in alignment with organizational objectives. Address challenges to meet targets by creating innovative concepts and understanding the business environment. Build and maintain strong relationships with clients, government bodies, consultants, and contractors through proactive engagement and follow-ups. Serve as a trusted advisor to customers by providing tailored solutions and expert guidance. Execute sales and marketing strategies in accordance with company policies and guidelines. Conduct market analysis to understand business environments, trends, and customer needs. Strengthen and promote the company’s image and business reputation among clients through consistent engagement, exceptional service, and tailored solutions. Conduct product demonstrations, presentations, and seminars to educate prospective customers about company products and services, including their features and benefits. Prepare detailed technical proposals, tenders, and quotations; generate inquiries, negotiate terms, and finalize orders with clients. Provide technical service, troubleshooting, and after-sales support to ensure customer satisfaction. Register the company as a qualified vendor/supplier with major enterprises and government organizations where required. Ensure compliance with all applicable regulations and standards. Maintain accurate and up-to-date electronic databases for all accounts and applications. Support receivables follow-up and help ensure timely collection of payments. Attend training sessions to continuously develop relevant knowledge and skills. Experience and Qualifications Candidates should possess 2-5 years of relevant experience. CVs must reference at least one revenue figure, deal size, or sales achievement; CVs without any numbers will be de-prioritized. Compensation and Benefits The compensation package for this role includes a competitive salary, an attractive commission scheme, and a housing allowance. Additional benefits comprise a company car (including fuel, maintenance, and insurance) and Class A medical insurance. Opportunities for career growth are also available.

1f2c7a471d44b215.description: About the Role Qiddiya Investment Company is seeking a Manager - Development to join their team in Riyadh, Riyadh Province. This full-time role involves leading and managing complex asset development projects from strategic planning and concept development through to operational readiness. The Development Manager ensures all activities align with approved business plans, development strategies, quality expectations, and governance requirements. Key Accountabilities The individual in this role will be responsible for the overall leadership and management of development projects, ensuring successful execution across all stages. Key accountabilities include: Leading development activities throughout the entire asset lifecycle. Driving Stage Gate submissions and securing governance approvals. Managing consultant procurement, contracts, and performance. Overseeing design quality, budgets, programmes, and risk management. Leading stakeholder engagement with operators, delivery partners, and authorities. Supporting construction, commissioning, and handover processes. Responsibilities by Development Phase Responsibilities are structured across various development phases, ensuring comprehensive project management: Concept Stage: Defining briefs, leading workshops, approving concepts, and managing budgets and risks. SD/DD Stage: Coordinating consultants, monitoring programme and quality, and reviewing design compliance. Construction Stage: Participating in site reviews, resolving issues, and monitoring permits and approvals. Handover: Supporting inspections, commissioning, defects management, and operational readiness. Leadership Responsibilities This role involves significant leadership, contributing to team development and strategic initiatives across the destination. The Manager - Development will provide leadership to development teams, mentor staff, influence stakeholders, and support strategic initiatives. Qualifications and Experience Candidates should possess a strong background in development management. A minimum of 5 to 10 years of relevant experience is required for this position. Application Process Interested candidates are encouraged to apply. Salary details will be disclosed during the interview process.

1f4f4bc8057c15c8.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مجموعة بن جارالله للمقاولات عن فني صيانة ميكانيكية للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يتولى شاغل الوظيفة مسؤولية تشخيص الأعطال الميكانيكية، ومتابعة تنفيذ أنشطة الصيانة الوقائية والإصلاحية، وضمان دقة أداء المعدات بعد الصيانة. هذا الدور بدوام كامل ويتطلب خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات. المسؤوليات الرئيسية تتبع المخططات الميكانيكية للمنظومات والأجهزة والمعدات الميكانيكية لتحديد إجراءات تشخيص الأعطال. تشخيص أعطال المنظومات والأجهزة والمعدات الميكانيكية، وتحديد أسبابها. تقدير كمية وتكلفة مواد ومستلزمات الصيانة ومتابعة توفيرها. متابعة تنفيذ أنشطة الصيانة اللازمة وإجراءات إصلاح الأعطال. فحص الأجهزة والمعدات الميكانيكية بعد الإصلاح للتأكد من دقة أدائها وضبطها. متابعة تنفيذ برامج الصيانة الوقائية للمنظومات والأجهزة والمعدات الميكانيكية وفقاً للخطط المحددة. إعداد وتقديم وتوثيق وحفظ تقارير العمل المتعلقة بالصيانة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال صيانة المعدات الميكانيكية. القدرة على قراءة وتتبع المخططات والرسومات الميكانيكية. معرفة قوية بأساليب تشخيص الأعطال الميكانيكية وتحديد أسبابها. بيئة العمل هذا الدور مخصص للعمل بدوام كامل ضمن فريق الصيانة في الرياض. سيعمل الفني ضمن بيئة ديناميكية تتطلب الدقة والالتزام ببرامج الصيانة المجدولة. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا المنصب سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات، وسيتم الإفصاح عنه خلال عملية المقابلة.

1ff0c40b2a814bfd.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة ألين التقنيه التجارية عن أخصائي مبيعات للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يهدف هذا الدور بدوام كامل إلى وضع سياسات البيع ومتابعة تنفيذها وتقييم النتائج، بالإضافة إلى إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بالمبيعات. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية دراسة ومتابعة تطورات السوق لتحديد وتطوير الأهداف التسويقية وطرق البيع. تقدير حجم المبيعات المتوقع وترجمة الأهداف إلى خطط بيعية قابلة للتنفيذ. اقتراح سياسات البيع ومتابعة تنفيذها، بالإضافة إلى وضع وتقييم البرامج الترويجية. التواصل الفعال مع العملاء لتحديد مشكلاتهم ومتابعة المنافسين وبرامجهم البيعية لتجنب المخاطر المستقبلية. تقييم أداء مندوبي المبيعات ومدى تحقيق الأهداف البيعية، واقتراح الخطط والإجراءات التصحيحية اللازمة. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بالمبيعات، وتقديم التوصيات والحلول المناسبة، وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال المبيعات أو ما يعادله. القدرة على تحليل بيانات السوق وتحديد الفرص. مهارات ممتازة في التواصل وبناء العلاقات مع العملاء. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات تحليلية قوية لتقييم الأداء البيعي ووضع الخطط التصحيحية. القدرة على إعداد التقارير والوثائق المتخصصة بدقة ووضوح. مهارات تنظيمية عالية لإدارة البيانات وحفظها. بيئة العمل يقع مقر العمل في الرياض، المملكة العربية السعودية، وهو دور بدوام كامل ضمن فريق شركة ألين التقنيه التجارية. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا الدور سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات بعد المقابلة.

1f7360077e2d189c.description: About AtkinsRéalis AtkinsRéalis is a global engineering services and nuclear organization. The company connects people, data, and technology to transform infrastructure and energy systems. Working with industry partners, clients, and a global team of consultants, designers, engineers, and project managers, AtkinsRéalis is committed to engineering a better future for the planet and its people. Role Overview AtkinsRéalis is seeking a Senior Project Manager (Sitewide Infrastructure) to join their team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves providing support to direct reports, fostering teamwork, contributing technical inputs to project teams, and ensuring client objectives are met. The Senior Project Manager will be a key member of the team, responsible for the successful delivery of projects within specified constraints. Key Responsibilities Ensure successful project delivery regarding progress, quality, and cost budgetary constraints. Review and approve technical documents submitted by the Developer to the Client, verifying compliance with Project Specifications. Monitor project deliverables to ensure they meet agreed standards and satisfy stakeholder requirements at each project stage. Oversee overall project stakeholder relationships and adjust engagement strategies and plans as needed. Develop and establish policies, procedures, and documentation for planning, developing, managing, executing, and controlling the project schedule, including monitoring tasks and workflows to ensure timely completion. Identify and document specific actions, including establishing milestones, required to produce project deliverables. Develop and implement policies, procedures, and documentation for planning, managing, expending, and controlling project costs. Identify and manage project issues through to resolution. Develop a robust change control system by setting a project baseline and identifying, reviewing, approving, and monitoring proposed changes to the project scope. This full-time position is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, and reports to the Regional Finance Director. The role involves managing a team of three and ensuring the integrity of financial information, a disciplined month-end close, effective controls, and compliance throughout the region. Key Responsibilities Manage monthly, quarterly, and year-end close processes for MENA entities, ensuring accurate results and timely reporting. Prepare and review management accounts, balance sheet reconciliations, and cash flow reports with clear commentary. Maintain the integrity of the general ledger, chart of accounts, master data, and intercompany balances. Ensure consistent application of Group accounting policies and IFRS requirements across all MENA entities. Lead regional statutory audits and coordinate the completion of financial statements and external reporting. Support the resolution of accounting issues affecting project reporting, including revenue recognition and contract arrangements. Maintain short and medium-term cash flow forecasts and support funding and liquidity decisions. Review accounts receivable, collections, billing, and accounts payable, focusing on reducing unbilled revenue and overdue receivables. Oversee payments, bank reconciliations, bank mandates, and treasury controls. Ensure compliance with accounting, tax, and regulatory requirements across MENA. Maintain and improve controls over purchasing, supplier onboarding, expenses, payroll inputs, and balance sheet accounts. Manage the effective use and development of NetSuite within the MENA finance function. Lead, coach, and develop a team of three, setting clear responsibilities and performance expectations. Required Experience and Capabilities 5-10 years of experience in financial control and reporting. Hands-on approach, comfortable with detailed accounting matters and wider regional business priorities. Commercially aware, with the ability to challenge assumptions and recommend practical solutions. Highly organised, capable of managing competing priorities and deadlines in a fast-moving environment. Clear communicator, able to translate financial issues into actionable steps for non-finance colleagues. High integrity, sound judgment, and a strong sense of ownership. Resilient, collaborative, and comfortable working across different cultures, entities, and locations. Team Leadership and Stakeholder Management This role involves leading, coaching, and developing a team of three finance professionals, ensuring they have the necessary knowledge and cross-cover for all key finance activities. The Regional Financial Controller will build a collaborative finance function that supports the business while maintaining appropriate challenge, accountability, and control. Effective relationships must be developed with regional leadership, business unit heads, project teams, Group Finance, HR, Operations, banks, auditors, and advisers. Systems and Process Improvement The Regional Financial Controller will own the effective use and ongoing development of NetSuite across the MENA finance function. This includes automating finance processes to reduce manual work, allowing the team to focus on review, analysis, and decision support. Establishing clear documentation for key finance processes, controls, and system procedures is also a core responsibility.

1f32c12a6161a5ec.job_title: Finance & Revenue Cycle Management (RCM) Specialist (Saudi Arabia)
1f32c12a6161a5ec.description: The KH Finance & Revenue Cycle Management (RCM) Specialist is responsible for overseeing the financial operations and revenue cycle management of KAUST Health, ensuring accurate financial reporting, effective budget management, and efficient insurance claims processing. The role focuses on validating invoices and quotations, managing end-to-end insurance claim activities, monitoring financial performance, and optimizing revenue collection while ensuring compliance with contractual agreements and healthcare regulations. Working closely with healthcare operators, insurance providers, finance teams, and senior leadership, the specialist plays a key role in improving financial sustainability, minimizing claim denials, strengthening financial controls, and supporting strategic decision-making through data-driven financial analysis and reporting. Key Responsibilities Review and validate invoices submitted by the healthcare operator to ensure accuracy, completeness, and compliance with contractual agreements before payment approval. Evaluate and approve quotations for healthcare services by verifying pricing, scope, and alignment with agreed contracts and organizational policies. Lead the annual budgeting process, including budget preparation, monitoring, forecasting, and expenditure control to support KAUST Health's financial objectives. Prepare financial reports and conduct variance analysis, providing monthly financial insights, forecasting, and recommendations to improve operational and financial performance. Manage the end-to-end Revenue Cycle Management (RCM) process, ensuring timely and accurate submission of insurance claims to all insurance providers. Validate insurance claims by reviewing billing accuracy, medical coding, documentation, and compliance with payer requirements to minimize claim denials. Monitor claim rejections, collections, and reimbursement performance, analyze denial trends, implement corrective actions, and improve cash flow and revenue recovery. Lead reconciliation meetings with healthcare operators and insurance companies to resolve payment discrepancies, outstanding claims, billing issues, and account reconciliations. Develop and present financial and revenue cycle KPIs to senior leadership, identifying financial risks, revenue optimization opportunities, and process improvement initiatives. Ensure financial compliance and stakeholder collaboration by supporting internal and external audits, maintaining compliance with financial policies and healthcare regulations, and serving as the primary liaison between KAUST Health, Finance, healthcare operators, and insurance companies. Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or a related discipline (Finance or Accounting preferred). Master's degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or Healthcare Management is preferred. Professional certification such as CPA, CMA, ACCA, or equivalent is considered an added advantage. Minimum of 6 years of professional experience, including at least 3 years in a leadership or specialist role in finance, healthcare finance, or revenue cycle management. Proven experience in healthcare finance, including budgeting, financial planning, financial reporting, cost control, and expenditure management within hospitals or healthcare organizations. Extensive knowledge of Revenue Cycle Management (RCM), including insurance claims processing, claim validation, reimbursement, denial management, collections, and financial reconciliation. Strong financial analysis and reporting skills, with experience in budget preparation, forecasting, variance analysis, KPI reporting, and financial performance management. Advanced Microsoft Excel proficiency, including Pivot Tables, XLOOKUP/VLOOKUP, financial modeling, dashboards, data analysis, and reporting; experience with ERP or healthcare financial systems is highly desirable.
